authorization.source: User asks this planner to specify the execution plan and will hand it to Sol to execute, explicitly rejecting another start-confirmation loop
authorization.planner_end: deliver concrete plan, contract and dispatch text; no research launch by this chat
authorization.executor_end: implement required adapters, preflight, one finite training segment, development, independent evaluation, offline profiles, audited reports and closeout
authorization.dispatch: Owner forwards this plan to Sol as an execution instruction. Sol proceeds through passed gates without asking whether to start.

question: Does one further finite training segment from M75 c20 improve strength while retaining two fixed out-of-training anchors?
causal_scope: One practical successor trajectory, not a multi-seed method claim; replacing the parent opponent follows the lineage and is not isolated from training length.

training.initialization: fresh AdamW optimizer and RNG; exact M75 weight warm-start
training.schedule: cycle_index=0..19, block=0..127, opponent=order[block%4], environment_seed=17001000+128*cycle_index+block; two seats each
training.truncation_policy: retain prefix and physical budget; exclude from terminal win/loss training; do not refill; ninth truncation stops training
training.candidate: fixed final cycle20 after all 5120 logical attempts accounted for; retain all cycle exports; no best-checkpoint or seed selection

development.role: fixed descriptive curve; same development grid at each checkpoint; no feedback into training or candidate selection

actor_binding.a: M79 fixed final c20, frozen by audit before first independent candidate game

evaluation.scope: 3072*3 common + 1024*2 latest coverage + 1024 direct; style-reference games excluded from competitive parent/candidate endpoints
evaluation.truncation_policy: retain attempts; no draw imputation, no seed replacement, no scientific retry. Ninth truncation stops new evaluation dispatch; report all completed evidence.

statistics.primary: (wins+0.5*draws)/planned complete endpoint games; incomplete endpoints never use completed-only rates as the formal statistic
statistics.resampling: First average two seats within each environment seed. For each common opponent compute candidate-minus-base paired block deltas. Each bootstrap replicate draws 256 indices independently for each opponent, shared between candidate/base; average six opponent means equally. Other endpoints use their own paired seed blocks.
statistics.decision: Candidate qualifies for the next mainline-parent recommendation only if both enhancement endpoints and all retention endpoints pass; this is not release or default-champion authorization. Otherwise retain candidate and report passed, failed, incomplete endpoints separately; no automatic extra samples.
statistics.missing: Any missing terminal/seat in an endpoint makes its frozen gate INCOMPLETE. Whole-round dispatch/reporting can finish; continue independent valid endpoints and deliver. Add diagnostic worst/best-case point bounds by assigning unknown half-draw scores 0/1, explicitly not outcomes or formal PASS.
statistics.power: Same 256 paired seeds/opponent and 512 direct as M75; maintains practical screening resolution, no claimed 80% power for +2pp or 3pp equivalence.

style.comparison: two independent comparisons: M79 versus parent M75, and M79 versus fixed Balance v0.2.0; never substitute the parent for the fixed style reference
metrics: first 4-5VP own Main conditional mean and coverage
own Main 12/24 score snapshots and survival coverage
real early-investment redemption by Main24 with cap3/investment cap24/game
style.missing: Keep full grid and failure ledger. For descriptive aggregates only use shared complete opponents across all three actors; excluded opponents explicit. If none, retain per-opponent available summaries and INSUFFICIENT. Missing metrics stay NOT_MEASURED; no repeated evaluation to force a label.
style.level_ceiling: DESCRIPTIVE; mixed/undetermined permitted; no confirmed style or version assignment

resources.effective_deadline: min(first_research_dispatch+30h, absolute_stop); bind ISO timestamp before first dispatch, never reset on resume
resources.concurrency: slots <= actual cpuset capacity; no simultaneous training and evaluation on dsw; after training audit, dsw may claim remaining evaluation shards; one shared lease/commit authority
resources.fallback: If only one research node is reachable, run stages serially there only after all capacity/runtime/parity checks pass; original caps and deadline remain. Do not wait for an idle second node as a launch prerequisite.
resources.engineering: saved replay fixtures, synthetic ledgers, parity, crash/resume simulations; no new-game smoke budget
resources.history: Private ModelScope for full history; keep weights, config, results, report, manifests/SHA and restore instructions locally; no automatic download of old full histories

recovery.infra_rule: Only interrupted jobs without committed valid terminal or scientific failure may retry same identity once; reconcile orphans first, retain all attempts and CPU. Commit terminal/update once. Full-state resume validates optimizer/RNG/cursors. No weight-only resume.
recovery.transfer_limit: each object retry episode <=600 seconds and bounded by effective deadline
recovery.persistent: bind existing persistent startup and server1 recovery to this execution only, terminate recovery at completion/deadline; never resurrect M75
recovery.idle_notifications: notify at entering wait, 30m, 45m and loss/recovery failure; research wait timer distinct from platform idle timer. Preserve currently paused Codex automation; do not create or unpause app schedules. Use running Sol observations and existing authorized persistent monitoring capability; disclose if no notification transport.
recovery.platform: Do not infer powered-off from SSH. If both research nodes require a platform start unavailable to Sol, provide exact blocker/action; no synthetic keepalive load.

required_before_first_game: complete generated schedule and global seed-overlap check
source archive and every member SHA
exact commands and zero-game preflight receipt
execution_binding.resolution: Sol fills machine-derived fields and hashes autonomously from actual evidence; these are verification results, not unresolved owner decisions.
execution_binding.source_policy: new isolated M79 deployment and independent adapters; retain M75 pinned sources/results. M75 scripts hard-code round, seeds and actor count; do not dispatch them unchanged.
execution_binding.all: context/read latest task revision, create or reuse M79 task; if unavailable save pending update and proceed with authorized research; do not start ALL service

delivery: final c20 and complete optimizer/RNG state with SHA
training/audit and complete logical/physical attempt budget ledger
frozen independent results and per-opponent/seat paired statistics
fixed-reference and parent descriptive replay profiles
candidate JSON/HTML/MD card with actual M79 state
result-bound human HTML/full Markdown plus audit and receipts
history archive/restore index and source snapshot

executor_reporting.after_start: report actual node/PID/create_time/execution SHA/path, first committed progress, deadline and measured ETA; continue authorized pipeline
stop_for_owner_only: both nodes inaccessible with unavailable platform-start capability
hard scientific/audit failure or exhausted retry/budget/deadline

implementation_entrypoints.required_adaptation: Archive currently loops a/base and carries M75-specific report text and exclusion. Extend via independent M79 adapter to a/base/style-reference, full declared grid and actual M79 next action; preserve M75 bytes.

numeric_blueprint_reference.policy: copy all numeric/network/runtime fields except explicit M79 identities, schedule, storage/attempt/recovery bounds; parity on actual environment required

runtime_reference.source_pin_policy: separate exact execution manifest before each first launch; never modify dispatched copies
